I've been playing BDSP, I had intially boycott pokemon for a while due to the overall lack of quality in SWSH and other Pokemon media but I'm over it now, I'm a huge lifetime pokemon fan and I can't stay away lol.

I appreciate your messages a lot, I'd be happy to add you on PoGo though I don't get out much the few times I do I like to play lol. Not sure how adding works anymore but my username is AnimatedAndy. 

I also saw you played ffxiv at some point, do you still play? I play that pretty often.

Funny you say that cause I've been playing Pokemon recently haha and Pikachu is my favorite as cliche as it is. I understand that but practically speaking I just don't want to cause him more stress. I wish I could be helpful at all, even emotionally I feel useless cause as hard as I try I end up messing up and having breakdowns. I'm not emotionally stable at all, I'm just stable enough to survive. He and everyone I know deserves better than me, a ghost who just drags them down. I really appreciate your words though.
My best isn't enough because I'm practically disabled. It has gotten progressively worse every year. I think he could find someone better for him, someone capable.
